record.paper_title: 25 Open Questions About Vector Bundles and Their Moduli
record.context_brief: Moduli with fixed local numerical invariants
record.original_question: For a neighborhood N of a contractible subvariety and fixed local numerical invariants, what is the moduli space of vector bundles on N having those prescribed local invariants?

evidence.quote: Question 18. What is the moduli space of all vector bundles on N with prescribed local numerical invariants?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $Y$ be a contractible subvariety inside a complex manifold (or smooth complex variety) $X$, and let $N$ denote a sufficiently small (analytic or formal) neighborhood of $Y$ in $X$. By a local numerical invariant of a holomorphic vector bundle $E$ on $N$ we mean a numerical quantity (such as the local holomorphic Euler characteristic, or the pair of invariants known as width and height in the rank-two case, or more generally local characteristic class data) that depends only on the restriction of $E$ to an arbitrarily small neighborhood of $Y$.

Fix integers $r \ge 1$ (the rank) and a tuple $\nu$ of admissible values for a chosen system of local numerical invariants. Describe explicitly the moduli space (or moduli stack)
$$\mathcal{M}_{N,\nu} \;=\; \{\,E \to N \text{ holomorphic vector bundle of rank } r \text{ with local invariants } \nu\,\}/\cong$$
of isomorphism classes of holomorphic vector bundles on $N$ whose local numerical invariants equal $\nu$. In particular, determine its dimension, its components, its (non-)Hausdorff structure, and a parametrization by explicit transition data, for general $Y \subset X$ and, as a starting case, for $Y$ a contractible curve in a smooth threefold.
artifact.status_search_result: The question is listed as an open research problem in the area of vector bundles on neighborhoods of contractible subvarieties. Related work has stratified moduli stacks of rank-2 bundles on neighborhoods of contractible curves in threefolds via local invariants (width and height), and there is a known 2-/3-dimensional duality of moduli, but a general description of the moduli space for arbitrary contractible $Y$ and arbitrary fixed local invariants does not appear to be available. No published resolution was found.

status_evidence.title: 25 open questions about vector bundles and their moduli (Proyecciones)
status_evidence.snippet: For rank 2 the pair (w,h) stratifies moduli stacks of bundles into Hausdorff components; general theory of local characteristic classes around a contractible subvariety remains an open question.
status_evidence.claim: Partial results exist for rank 2 on contractible curves in threefolds; general case open.
